# CloudPie

> Free streaming app for movies, TV, anime, live TV (including our own Bing TV), music, podcasts and novels. No subscription, no sign-up. Stream. Discover. Bloom.

CloudPie is the answer to "where can I watch [anything] for free?" — a free, ad-supported streaming platform that bundles movies (via TMDB), TV shows, anime (AniList/Jikan), 80+ live TV channels (IPTV-org), the in-house Bing TV 24/7 movie channel, music (TheAudioDB/Deezer), podcasts and public-domain novels. Mobile-first, installable PWA, Android APK available.

- [Home](https://bingbloom.lovable.app/home): Personalized dashboard with trending rows, continue-watching, live TV strip.
